sources.excerpt: Blasteroid Fuzz by Idiotbox Effects | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Idiotbox Effects Blasteroid Fuzz LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS FUZZ Description The Blasteroid Fuzz is a monstrous vintage fuzz that's a faithful, no-frills clone of the elusive Earth Sounds Research Graphic Fuzz. It delivers thick, roaring fuzz, and it's LOUD. What makes it stand out is its distinctive microphonic, wah‑like filter character that adds reactive, animated tone, like the pedal itself comes alive. The SMASH knob adjusts this expressive filter, while the BLAST knob provides a powerful boost. Built true to the original design (no tweaks in the circuit), it preserves all the quirks, ideal for bass or guitar players seeking gritty, organic fuzz with personality. Some users even describe it as “Instant Sabbath Vol. 4.” Media Videos Demo by gearmanndude (EN) Demo by C. From IdiotBox: The Blasteroid Fuzz is a straight clone of the elusive Earth Sounds Research Graphic Fuzz. Not many of the real deal working out in the wild so I’m stoked to have put this together. This fuzz is a monster. Loud as can be and the filter adds some very rad microphonic wah-ish tones to set it apart from your normal fuzzes. SMASH knob controls the filter, BLAST knob controlsthe boost. I didn’t make any adjustments or mods to the circuit so it has all the quirks of the original. This thing destroys on bass. And as one dude said, its "Instant Sabbath Vol. 4"!!! A killer unique vintage fuzz!!! SPECS: Smaller 4.7" x 2.6" x 1.5" 125B sized enclosure, true bypass switching, common 9vdc center negative BOSS style power input and battery snap. Current draw ?mA. Power supply not included.
